title: 订单豹 MCP 对接配置
description: 填写订单豹 ERP 账号，用于代客下单、查客户、库存、采购和财务。账号和密码仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your DingDanBao ERP account for ordering on behalf of customers, looking up customers, stock, purchasing, and finance. Username and password are stored only in ~/.workbuddy on this device and are not uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel: 请使用订单豹后台账号密码配置或联系我们获取账号密码
docLabel_en: Please configure with your DingDanBao backend account and password, or contact us to obtain credentials.

fields.label: 登录密码
fields.description: 订单豹登录密码。仅存本机，请勿发给对话里的智能体。
fields.description_en: DingDanBao login password. Stored on this device only; never send it to the agent in chat.
